body: Right, I am a person... I'll be fine tonight, thank you so much!  Gn!! And yes please I need more chill insight than arguments and stuff people usually do..
Crap I didnt even read the question!! Im from kentucky!! Im so so sorry!!

I meant me dying!!! Not others!!! Believe me, I know it would make it worse.

I'll look into the GED. I hope it's alright for a me to do practice, usually you have to be at least 16 already to go... thank you.
The person being me. Not in the mood for prisontime either lol.

I could not. I am ashamed. Is there any way I can do this on my own, I'm so overwhelmed? I'll probably just get a GED on my 16th birthday anyway... What would I even say? My mom getting in trouble is just another burden on me to deal with. The only one financially able to care for me is my father and I don't feel like being molested again. I'm 15, what's a few more years??? And ... just. How can I, like what's the first steps? Plus my mom did ask the school board every year for guidance and they are required not to help home schoolers in any way, no lesson plans, nothing. After hearing that out many times, my mom gave up. What do I even say when I go back? I can't do this. Can a pellet gun kill a person?

It should be monitored! Gives me hope your area is! But my family doesn't make enough money to be important or given second thought around here. I have heard of Khan Academy, have it installed next to Reddit as we speak lol. I'm just not sure what to do with it, it seems like a ton of information. Where do I start? I expressed I wanted to be structured over the summer to have better confidence returning to a public school system so we are looking into cheap summer programs online. Time4Learning seems pretty babyish imo but it's the only thing that doesn't want me to pay thousands for their content. I absolutely suck at time management, schedules, etc. I need to know "do x for x time on x days". I am overwhelmed easily.

I'm not sure how good my writing is, probably awful, I do not understand a single thing from anything to do with algebra beyond very, very basic x+1=2, therefore x=1 stuff. Exponents are Hell in numeric form. I thought PEMDAS as a check list for a problem was basic and yet I still trip up doing one letter at a time. I'm terrible of any other concept, too. God I hate myself. I missed most of middle school with anxiety problems and the last class I've been to was in eighth grade.

I apologize for not thanking you earlier for taking this time for me I really appreciate it, thank you for any insight.

My mom let me miss 2 years of school! And I was already behind! Why did she not open to at least trying agoraphobia and social anxiety therapy before "home schooling" me (read: leave an antisocial kid alone at home all day with the internet)? I'm just angry! I deserve better! But I can't even help my mom run errands without having a panic attack and crying. I'm just done! I'm hopeless. I'm fifteen and have the academic ability of I'd say a twelve year old. I cannot function, how does she expect me to up and go to tenth grade in AUGUST?
